meta.tagline: Train with purpose. Build results that last.

transformations.heading: Real people. Real work. Real progress.
transformations.body: Progress is not created by one perfect week. It comes from following the right plan, measuring what matters and making consistent adjustments over time.

servicesIntro.heading: Choose the level of support that fits you
servicesIntro.body: Whether you want face-to-face coaching in Cwmbran, complete online support or a combination of both, the goal is the same: a clear plan, measurable progress and no more guesswork.

process.heading: A clear process. No guesswork.
process.body: We start with where you are now, build around your real life and adjust the plan using your progress - not guesswork.

steps.title: Free consultation
steps.body: We talk through your goal, training experience, schedule, lifestyle and what has been holding you back.

steps.title: Your individual plan
steps.body: You get a programme matched to your goal, ability, available equipment and weekly schedule.

steps.title: Train and track
steps.body: You follow the plan while we track training, body data, adherence and the markers that matter for your goal.

steps.title: Review and adjust
steps.body: We keep what is working and make changes when your progress, performance or adherence shows they are needed.

story.heading: I know what it feels like to start from the beginning.
story.imageAlt: Kacper Kaszowski, personal trainer in Cwmbran and founder of KK Coaching
story.bodyFull: I'm Kacper Kaszowski, founder of KK Coaching and a Level 3 Personal Trainer based in Cwmbran. I did not get into fitness because staying in shape had always been easy for me. I started at around 117 kg, struggled with my confidence and made many of the same mistakes that hold people back: overcomplicating nutrition, chasing quick results and not knowing whether my training was actually working. Through consistency, education and a more structured approach, I reached 76 kg and later completely rebuilt my physique. That process taught me the difference between a plan that looks impressive on paper and one a real person can follow for long enough to produce results. Today I use that experience to help people lose fat, build muscle, train with confidence and create routines they can maintain in real life.
story.bodyShort: I'm Kacper Kaszowski, founder of KK Coaching and a personal trainer based in Cwmbran. My own journey took me from around 117 kg to 76 kg before I rebuilt my physique. Now I use that experience to help other people stop guessing, train with purpose and build results they can maintain.

finalCta.heading: Ready to stop starting over?
finalCta.body: Tell me where you are now, what you want to achieve and what has been getting in the way. We will work out the most suitable way to move forward.

hero.heading: Personal Trainer in Cwmbran & Online Fitness Coaching
hero.lead: Tired of random workouts, diets you can't stick to or starting over every few weeks? Get a clear training plan, practical nutrition targets and ongoing support built around your goal, schedule and experience.
hero.trustLine: 1:1 at JD Gyms Cwmbran • My own 117 → 76 kg transformation • Individual coaching, no generic plans
hero.imageAlt: Kacper Kaszowski, personal trainer in Cwmbran and founder of KK Coaching

whoItsFor.heading: A plan built around your goal - and your real life.
whoItsFor.body: You do not need perfect genetics, endless free time or years of gym experience. You need a plan you understand, a way to measure progress and support that helps you stay consistent when life is not perfect.

cards.title: Lose fat without another crash diet
cards.body: Build a calorie deficit you can actually stick to and adjust it as your progress changes.

cards.title: Build muscle with a structured plan
cards.body: Stop jumping between random workouts and know exactly how your training is progressing.

cards.title: Feel confident in the gym
cards.body: Learn technique, understand your programme and stop wondering if you are doing everything wrong.

cards.title: Get back on track and stay consistent
cards.body: Whether you have had a break, a busy few months or simply lost momentum, we will build a routine you can maintain.
